description: This file defines an interface 'PolicyAdapter' for policy adapters within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project. It specifies default methods for getting groups and channels related to policies.

classes.name: PolicyAdapter
classes.description: A Java interface serving as a mixin for policy adapters, providing default group and channel sets for policies.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns a set containing the 'POLICIES' group from TopicPath.Group.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns a set containing 'NONE' channel from TopicPath.Channel.
